# Veloura

Veloura is a personalized e-commerce storefront for product discovery, catalog browsing, search, recommendations, product comparison, wishlist, cart, checkout, orders, returns, and a catalog-grounded AI shopping assistant called ShopAI.

Canonical site: https://web-lyart-three-94.vercel.app

## When to use Veloura

Use Veloura to browse products by category, search the catalog, inspect product details, compare products, or discover recommendations. Use ShopAI for catalog-grounded shopping guidance by need, budget, or use case.

Start with /shop or /search, use /sitemap.xml to discover product and category URLs, and read the current product page for prices and availability. Recommendations and ShopAI are interactive features; they are not MCP tools. Account and purchase actions require the shopper's own session and consent.

## Public URLs

- Home: /
- Shop catalog: /shop
- Search: /search
- Recommendations: /recommendations
- ShopAI: /ai-shopping
- Product comparison: /compare
- About: /about
- Contact: /contact
- Privacy: /privacy
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Robots: /robots.txt
- OpenAPI: /openapi.json
- [Veloura developer resources](https://web-lyart-three-94.vercel.app/developers): Public resource formats and MCP connection instructions.
- [Veloura MCP endpoint](https://web-lyart-three-94.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): Read-only site guidance over Streamable HTTP.
- [Veloura MCP server card](https://web-lyart-three-94.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json): Connection URL and supported capabilities.

## Developer resources

Read /developers for public resource formats and MCP connection instructions. The MCP Streamable HTTP endpoint is /.well-known/mcp; POST an initialize request to connect. It exposes read-only site guidance through resources/list and resources/read, with no account, payment, or administration tools.

## Catalog

Public product pages are available under /products/{slug}. Public category pages are available under /category/{slug}. Use sitemap.xml for the current generated list when available.

## Boundaries

Do not treat private account, admin, cart, checkout, order, or internal API routes as public documentation. Product data, prices, availability, and images should be read from visible catalog pages or public metadata, not invented.
